그들의 목걸이는 펜던트 부분과 비쥬들로 이루어져 있습니다. 각각의 보석들: Their necklaces consist of a pendant and several bijoux. Each gem holds great magical power, but the pendant is truly the essence of that power. The necklace itself is made of extremely rare mana stones, and it could prove useful in our efforts to build strength against the vampires. It may even reveal the source of their power.
Yes. I'll always keep that in mind. I'll be on my way now.
만약 누군가에게 그 목걸이가 있다면 매우 값진 아이템들과 바꾸어 드려야겠: If anyone has that necklace, I should exchange it for very valuable items. Of course, the value will vary depending on whether it's the pendant or a bijou.
I'd like to exchange my pendant for an item.
I'd like to exchange my bijou for an item.
Thank you for talking with me for so long.
In him was life, and that life was the light of all people.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
그대들이 원한다면 더 많은 가르침을 드리겠습니다. 항상 저를 믿고 함께: If you wish it, I will give you further teachings. Please always trust me and stay by my side.
제 영혼의 명은 '카리사스' 입니다. 현재 라비니아님의 육신을 빌리고 있: My soul's name is 'Karisas.' I am currently borrowing Lavinia's body.
Lavinia... I am always grateful to her, and always sorry as well.
If you'd like to adjust your skill level, I'll be glad to help, so don't hesitate to ask.
카스탈로 밖에 쳐진 결계는 일족의 목숨과도 같은 것입니다. 여러분들의 지: The barrier set up outside Castalo is as precious as our clan's very life. We need your wisdom.
일족의 미래는 여러분의 손에 달려있습니다. 부디 저에게 힘을 빌려주십시오: The future of our clan rests in your hands. Please lend me your strength.
당신은 현재 습득한 마법의 힘을 다른 쪽으로 돌리고 싶어하는 군요. 알겠: I see you wish to redirect the magical power you've acquired. Understood. I believe I can be of some small help. However, since there are those with selfish intentions who would abuse this, I require an appropriate price in return. Shall we go ahead and adjust your skill level?
I'm sorry. I don't think I can pay a sufficient price.
I understand well enough that you wish to protect our precious barrier. But there are things that strength and courage alone cannot accomplish. Perhaps it would be good to put your wisdom through a small test.
길게 설명할 시간이 없습니다. 사악한 무리들이 우리의 소중한 보금자리를: There's no time for a long explanation. A wicked band is trying to harm our precious home. We urgently need a pendulum to detect magical power. But to use it, we need a dowsing rod made from a special mineral. Can you find 10 pieces of this mineral for us?
That won't be easy. Let me think about it.
Please find 8 %(Target) in %(QuestZone) and bring them to me.
여러분들의 수고로 광물조각은 충분히 마련할 수 있었습니다. 하지만 이를: Thanks to your efforts, we were able to gather enough mineral fragments. However, refining them requires a substance called Refinium. I'm told it can only be obtained from a certain mine northeast of Castalo. That place is said to keep intruders out with invisible walls and traps, so please be extra careful. What do you say?
펜듀럼과 다우징을 이용하여 조사한 결과 결계를 지킬 열쇠가 담긴 마도서는: Using the pendulum and the dowsing rod, our investigation revealed the location of a clay doll that can lead us to the grimoire holding the key to protecting the barrier. This clay doll is said to be shattered into pieces scattered across various regions of Eslania. Can you gather all the fragments of the clay doll and piece it back together?
Gather all the shattered pieces of the clay doll in %(QuestZone) and bring them back together.
다행히도 마도서를 찾는 데는 성공했습니다. 하지만 이를 해석하기 위해서: Fortunately, we succeeded in finding the grimoire. But to decipher it, we must find five kinds of mana stones and complete a code table. To complete the code table correctly, you must combine the spells inscribed on the mana stones, fitting each one in so it avoids matching the spells of the mana stones adjacent to it, up, down, left, and right. I believe it will make intuitive sense once you look closely at the code table. Please give it your all to the very end, for the sake of our clan. What do you say? If you're willing, please take the code table.
What do you intend to do about the mission you're carrying out...? Our clan's survival is at stake.
임무를 무사히 수행하신 것 같군요. 그렇다면 그에 따른 보상 문제부터 확: It looks like you've completed the mission safely. In that case, shall we settle the matter of your reward before taking on the next mission?
훌륭합니다. 제가 미처 현자를 알아보지 못했군요. 하지만 테스트를 받았다: Excellent. I failed to recognize a sage when I saw one. But just because you took the test doesn't mean you have to carry out the mission. Simply taking the test is enough to qualify you for a reward. Whether to carry out the official mission is entirely your choice. So, will you take the reward, or will you carry out the official mission?
아니, 이것이 그 광물 조각이란 말입니까? 정말 수고 많았습니다. 그럼: Why, is this truly the mineral fragment? You've worked very hard indeed. Then I imagine you're capable of carrying out the next mission as well. As before, you're not obligated to carry it out. Simply completing this mission is enough to qualify you for a reward. The next mission will be more dangerous and difficult. That, too, is entirely your choice. So, will you take the reward, or will you carry out the next mission? Please, think of our clan's future.
I am already prepared to give everything for the sake of the clan.
대단하군요. 놀랍습니다. 정말 수고 많았습니다. 그럼 다음 임무도 수행하: Remarkable. Astonishing. You've truly worked hard. Then I imagine you're capable of carrying out the next mission as well. As before, you're not obligated to carry it out. Simply completing this mission is enough to qualify you for a reward. The next mission will be more dangerous and difficult. That, too, is entirely your choice. So, will you take the reward, or will you carry out the next mission? Please, think of our clan's future.
벌써 코드표를 완성했단 말입니까? 놀랍습니다. 당신이 일족들을 위하여 이: You've already completed the code table? Astonishing. I promise the reward for what you've achieved for our clan will not disappoint you in the least. Now we can protect the barrier with peace of mind. Truly, it would be no exaggeration to call you the hero who saved our clan.
I merely did what was natural.
보상을 바라고 하시는 일이 아니라고 생각했는데 섭섭합니다. 게다가 임무도: I thought you weren't doing this for the sake of a reward, so I'm disappointed. And on top of that, you haven't even completed the mission.
정말 힘들다고 하신다면 어쩔 수 없군요. 하지만 이로써 일족의 미래는 한: If you truly say it's too difficult, then there's nothing to be done. But this only darkens our clan's future further. Are you truly going to give up?
I need a bit more preparation. I will definitely try again later.
No. I just had a momentary lapse in judgment.
It's too difficult. I'd like to receive the reward for the previous quest.
No. I just had a momentary lapse in judgment.
그렇게까지 말씀하신다면 어쩔 수 없군요. 하지만 저를 봐서라도 다시 한번: If you insist to that extent, there's nothing to be done. But for my sake, won't you reconsider once more?
제가 당신에게 임무를 맡겼었습니까?: Did I assign you a mission?
예? 이미 훌륭하게 임무를 완수하지시 않았습니까. 어서 보상이나 받으시도: What? Haven't you already completed the mission splendidly? Go on and receive your reward.
오, 불이여, 셀라임의 아들이여, 저 비록 하찮은 존재이나 지금부터 영원: O Fire, son of Selaim, though I am but a lowly being, let me dwell from now until eternity in your holy light, in the place overflowing with your perfect happiness and blessing. Grant my soul a fitting reward, a beautiful renown, and everlasting joy. Hello. I am Amata, and I am responsible for keeping your belongings. How may I help you?
I'd like to see the items I have in storage.
I'd like to see the accessories I need.
I'd like to sell my items.
I'm here about the Pixie (pet) quest.
몬스터 사냥 퀘스트가 무엇인가요?: What is the monster hunting quest?
I've completed the monster hunting quest. I'd like my reward.
It's too difficult. I'll give up partway through.
Well then, I'll be heading back now.
네메세-테 아타르슈 세라이뮤 후다오 마지슈타 야지타: 네메세-테 아타르슈 세라이뮤 후다오 마지슈타 야지타
'셀라임의 불이여, 자비가 넘치는 가장 위대한 영혼의 보호자여.'라는 뜻: It means, 'O Fire of Selaim, greatest guardian of souls, overflowing with mercy.'
제 기억력이 그다지 좋지 못해서요. 만약 부탁하신 일이 있으시다면, 자주: My memory isn't very good, I'm afraid. If there's something you've asked of me, please feel free to ask me again.
The happiness you wish to attain shall be given only through the fire and righteousness of your spirit.
I am merely a conduit conveying the will of the fire spirit, Selaim. I am quite lacking, but please watch over me with patience.
픽시는 항상 여러분 곁에 있습니다. 다만 이들의 도움을 받기 위해서는 강: Pixies are always by your side. However, to receive their help, strong faith must accompany you. If I'm not mistaken, I believe you too possess unwavering faith.
픽시 퀘스트를 완료하였습니다. 보상은?: I've completed the Pixie quest. Where's my reward?
수행 레벨에 도달하신걸 축하 드립니다. 아시다시피 픽시는 우리들을 도와주: Congratulations on reaching the required level. As you know, among the many spirits who help us, pixies are the most timid. They're of the greatest help when it comes to punishing those who stain our sacred ground with blood, but in dangerous situations, they tend to shrink away entirely. They want to be certain of you as their future master. If they can trust you absolutely, they will become very good friends. Can you show me your ability? %(MonsterName) seems suited to your level. If you hunt down 80 of them within a time limit of one hour, they'll be convinced. Show me what you can do.
Yes, it's too much for me to handle.
I've changed my mind. I'll give it another try.
이상하군요. 퀘스트 신청 명단에 당신의 이름이 없군요: That's strange. Your name isn't on the quest application list.
어쩔 수 없군요. 나중에 언제든 다시 한번 도전해보세요: There's nothing to be done. Feel free to try again anytime later.
바람의 실피드여, 당신의 거룩한 계획을 내게 알리사 내가 진리를 깨닫게: O Sylph of the wind, reveal to me your holy plan, that I may awaken to truth, and let this teaching that has captured my spirit be revealed to all the world. I am Lipatti, one gifted with healing power. If you have a troublesome wound, please come find me. If it's something I can heal, I'll help you.
I'd like to have my wounds healed.
I'd like to buy summoning stones or recovery items.
I'd like to move to Caligo Dungeon (level-based war zone).
Thank you for all your hard work, as always. I'll be heading back now.
우리는 생각, 가르침, 뜻, 신념, 언어, 내면의 모습 등 그 어느것도: In thought, teaching, will, belief, language, and inner nature, we share nothing in common — we are entirely separate beings.
육체에 입은 물리적 상처는 쉽게 치료할 수 있습니다. 하지만 영혼에 입은: Physical wounds to the body can be healed easily. But wounds to the soul are not so easily healed.
All I can do is heal the wounds inflicted on the body.
자신의 사소한 행동 하나에도 영혼의 상처를 받는 사람이 있다는 걸 기억하: Remember that even one small action of yours can wound another person's soul.
정령족과의 혼혈이라는 이유로 힘들게 자라왔지만, 결코 부모님을 원망하지는: I grew up with hardship for being of mixed spirit blood, but I have never resented my parents for it.
그분들은 저에게 자신들이 할 수 있는 최선의 노력으로 절 키워주셨으니까요: Because they raised me with the very best effort they could give.
물의 엘라임이시여. 진리와 의의 표상인 당신이 어떤 일을 하셔도, 우리는: O Elaim of the water. Whatever you do, you who are the very emblem of truth and righteousness, we shall serve you with pure hearts. May all who dwell in your tranquil realm attain maturity through a pure village. Water is like a mirror for the soul, purifying you. Always remember this. How may I help you?
I'd like to borrow the Sign of the Blood Scripture.
I'd like to go to the Ouster village.
I'd like to see my storage.
I'd like to repair my item.
I'd like to go to the Free Battle Zone (Banatul).
Everyone reveals their beliefs, whether false or true, whether bright or dark.
또한 마음속에 의심이 일어나면 어디서나 믿음과 헌신이 그 영혼을 안내할: And when doubt arises in the heart, faith and devotion will guide that soul wherever it may be.
My companions are currently sealed within the frozen Timor Lake.
하루라도 빨리 그들을 구할 수 있는 방편을 마련해야 하는데, 아직 저의: I need to find a way to save them as soon as possible, but with my strength alone as it is……
각 속성에 따른 정령들은 정령마다 그 계급이 있습니다. 하급 운디네, 중: Spirits of each element have their own ranks. Lesser Undine, Intermediate Undain,……
상급인 엔다이론, 최상급은 엘레스트라이며 물의 정령의 왕은 엘라임이라고: the greater Endairon, and the highest is Elestra, while the king of the water spirits is called Elaim.
Items purchased from the Daden Market or received as gifts are kept in this shopping basket. You can come to me to retrieve stored items as well. Did you know? Unlike storage, the shopping basket only holds items you received as gifts or purchased — you cannot store your own items in it the way you would with storage. If some of your purchased items don't appear in the basket, don't worry — they aren't lost, they'll appear once you've retrieved the current items in the basket. Shall we take a look at the basket, then?
COME BACK,2005 이벤트 대상자로부터 추천을 받으셨다고요? 좋은: You were referred by a COME BACK 2005 event participant? That's wonderful. I can't just sit by. Please take this item. We hope for many more referrals from you in the future.
땅의 노아스여, 귀한 말씀과 고결한 행동을 내게 가르치사 깨끗한 생각과: O Noas of the earth, teach me precious words and noble deeds, that I may worship you with clean thoughts and a pure heart. O Earth, let me enjoy, through your power, a new life overflowing with truth. Greetings. I am Sioram, the earth spirit. What business do you have with me?
I'd like to go to the Free Battle Zone.
I'd like to make a contract to use the Earth Spirit's Horn.
I'd like to borrow the Sign of the Blood Scripture.
I'd like to go to the Perona Highway.
자유 대결 지대는 종족에 관계없이 대결을 즐길 수 있는 '바나툴'이 있다: In the Free Battle Zone, there is 'Banatul,' where you can enjoy battle regardless of race.
길드때문이라... 구체적으로 어떤 것을 원하는건가?: Regarding the guild... What exactly do you want?
I've come to register a guild.
I'd like to view the waiting guild list.
I'd like to view the guild list.
I'd like to leave the guild.
길드를 탈퇴하겠다고? 신중하게 생각해 보았다면 알겠네. 자네의 탈퇴 신청: You want to leave the guild? If you've thought it over carefully, then very well. I'll accept your request to leave. But know this: even after leaving, you cannot join another guild right away. Since you broke the pact with your own hand, a full week must pass in real time before you can go elsewhere. It won't be that easy~
대지 정령과의 계약에 응하면 대지 정령의 뿔이 있는 곳들은 자유롭게 이동: If you accept a contract with the earth spirit, you'll be able to freely travel to any place with an Earth Spirit's Horn. Of course, you must pay a corresponding price each time you use it. The earth fairies who oversee this are extremely greedy, you see. They even set different prices depending on who they're dealing with. So, what do you say? Will you make a contract with the earth spirit?
Yes, I'd like to entrust my small soul to the protection of the earth spirit.
Haven't you already made the contract? Don't worry, feel free to use it.
Those who follow righteousness and purity shall enjoy the light of paradise as their eternal resting place.
그러나 빛을 찾지 못한 자는 탄식과 불안의 어둠 속에 영원히 머물게 될: But those who fail to find the light shall remain forever in a darkness of lamentation and anxiety.
난 여행을 좋아한다네. 자네는 어떤가? 새로운 세상과 사람들, 문화까지,: I love to travel. What about you? New worlds, new people, new cultures — all of this is the true charm of travel.
If you ever get the chance, you should enjoy traveling too. You can learn a great deal from it.
여행도 즐겁지만, 지금은 자네들과 함께 하는 이 생활이 나의 가장 큰 기: Travel is enjoyable, but right now, this life spent together with you all is my greatest joy.
If you're ever in trouble, don't hesitate to come find me.
If you wish to use the Earth Spirit's Horn, make the contract through me.
I'd like to participate in the fundraiser on behalf of the guild.
죄송합니다. %(UserName)님께서는 현재 길드에 가입되어 있지 않으: I'm sorry. It seems %(UserName) is not currently in a guild, or is not a full guild member. If you're not part of a guild, please participate as an individual.
감사합니다. %(UserName)님께서는 %(GuildName)의 길드원: Thank you. As a member of %(GuildName), you are donating in the name of %(GuildName). The amount you've donated will be posted on the website under your guild's name. The amount displayed will be the combined total. The precious donations gathered in the name of %(GuildName) will be put to good use wherever they are truly needed, wherever a caring hand is required.
카리사스여, 당신의 귀한 가르침을 아는 신실한 성도는 과연 어디에 있습니: O Karisas, where indeed are the faithful believers who know your precious teachings? Even should I fall into hardship and distress, I shall not leave you, and I shall spread your teachings far and wide. My Karisas, I acknowledge you and you alone. Therefore, be my sole refuge and my savior. I am Manescu, aide to Lady Lavinia. What business do you have?
I'd like to buy a new weapon.
I'd like to adjust my alignment.
'승직'에 대해 알려주시겠습니까?: Could you tell me about 'Class Advancement'?
I've come because I need a Class Advancement item.
카리사스님의 뜻을 어기다니.. 간단히 끝날 문제는 아니군요. 하지만 지금: To defy Lord Karisas's will... this is not a simple matter. But since we're in a time of war, let's resolve it in a way that benefits us both. If you make a donation, I'll adjust your alignment. Of course, remember that the outcome will vary depending on the amount you donate. What will you do?
That's too great a burden for me. I'll come back another time.
Let us be your faithful servants who renew the world.
제가 모시는 분은 카리사스님이지 당신들이 아닙니다. 본인이 해결할 수 있: The one I serve is Lord Karisas, not you. Handle what you can handle yourselves.
전 언제나 카리사스 당신의 완벽한 부활을 원합니다. 지금의 불안정한 육신: I always wish for your perfect resurrection, Karisas. Cast aside this unstable body of yours now, and show us once more your perfect form.
제가 존재의 이유는 '카리사스'님 이십니다. 제가 살아가야 하는 이유를: The reason for my existence is Lord Karisas. He is the one who gave me a reason to live.
카리사스여 당신께 여쭈니 말씀해 주소서. 어떻게 해야 진리와 의를 통해: O Karisas, I ask of you, please tell me. How, through truth and righteousness, can I control the ten horses called the senses, which move according to thought?
당신이 그럴만한 자격이 있는지 의심스럽지만 궁금하다니 알려드리죠.\n\t:
I doubt you're truly qualified for this, but since you're curious, I'll tell you.
		Our power is limitless. It's simply that, until now, we've restrained ourselves from using it in meaningless violence. But we can no longer stand by as outside forces grow ever stronger. The time has come to unleash that power — to be reborn as a warrior with even greater ability. Of course, earning that recognition isn't easy. Shouldn't that much effort be required to gain the right to use techniques and equipment once considered forbidden?
정령사에게 있어 무엇보다 중요한 것은 정령왕의 소환이나 강한 힘의 추구가: For a spirit master, what matters most is not summoning the spirit king or pursuing great power, but a heart that loves and cherishes nature.
I've heard it's even possible to summon the spirit kings of all four elements.
This place, Adam's Sanctuary, must be protected by us Ousters.
Guarding the Blood Scripture is truly the Ousters' sacred duty.
Even I, once called the strongest spirit master, am reduced to merely guarding this entrance.
For an ordinary spirit master, summoning the spirit king is nothing more than a dream.
강인한 육체적 능력을 가지고 있음에도 이를 단련시키지 않으면 그저 나약한: Even with strong physical ability, if you fail to train it, you'll end up nothing but a weakling.
차크람이야 말로 진정한 무기이다. 과학이랍시고 만든 어설픈 슬레이어들의: The chakram is the true weapon. The Slayers' clumsy so-called scientific weapons, and the vampires' claws, are utterly helpless against our chakram.
마법을 사용하는 아우스터즈들과는 우리는 소환하는 정령에 차이가 있다네…: Compared to Ousters who use magic, we differ in the spirits we summon…
